brainstormingDecisions.title: Decisions
brainstormingDecisions.intro: Keep the conclusions, reasons and ideas behind an agreement together. Use decisions whenever they help your team.
brainstormingDecisions.emptyHelp: Select shared ideas or a group to propose a decision. You can keep exploring before agreeing.
brainstormingDecisions.discussionHint: Resolving does not accept; accepting does not resolve.

about.title: Decisions about {name}
about.tooltip: {count} decision about {name} · {pending} to apply | {count} decisions about {name} · {pending} to apply

verbHints.create: Something new is created in the content.
verbHints.change: Existing content is edited to match.
verbHints.test: A prototype or playtest before committing.
verbHints.keep: Confirms what already exists; usually nothing to apply.
verbHints.discard: Rules an option out; usually nothing to apply.

brainstormingDecisions.nothingToApply: Nothing to apply for a decision with no affected content.
brainstormingDecisions.markStatement: A statement, not a verification. The note goes into the decision’s history.
brainstormingDecisions.notePlaceholder: Optional note — what did you change?
brainstormingDecisions.acceptHelp: Accept the conclusion above with the source versions shown here.
brainstormingDecisions.waitingForOwner: Waiting for {name} to accept this proposal.
brainstormingDecisions.withdrawHelp: Appends a “Withdrawn” record. The proposal stays in the history.
brainstormingDecisions.withdrawRevisionHelp: Withdrawing the revision keeps the current agreement in force.
brainstormingDecisions.retiredWithdrawn: A withdrawn proposal cannot be edited or accepted. Propose a new decision instead.
brainstormingDecisions.retiredSuperseded: A superseded decision is read-only. Its replacement carries the current agreement.
brainstormingDecisions.previousAgreement: Current agreement — kept until the revision is accepted
brainstormingDecisions.historyCount: {count} record · newest first | {count} records · newest first
brainstormingDecisions.chooseSources: Choose the shared ideas or groups behind this proposal.
brainstormingDecisions.contextHint: select more notes on the board to add them
brainstormingDecisions.searchHelp: Search for a shared idea or group in this exploration.
brainstormingDecisions.noSourceResults: No shared sources match this search.
brainstormingDecisions.sourceUnavailableHelp: This source is no longer accessible. Its saved text is hidden.
brainstormingDecisions.replaceUnavailable: Remove or replace unavailable sources before saving.
brainstormingDecisions.sourceChanged: This source has changed. The consulted version is preserved.
brainstormingDecisions.sharedSourcesOnly: Choose 1 to 20 shared ideas to propose a decision.
brainstormingDecisions.conclusionPlaceholder: What do you propose agreeing on?
brainstormingDecisions.somethingNewHelp: a label and a type, created later
brainstormingDecisions.reasonPlaceholder: Why this option? What matters to the team?
brainstormingDecisions.assignHelp: Only the responsible person or the project owner can change this assignment.
brainstormingDecisions.registerPreview: You will accept this yourself when you register it.
brainstormingDecisions.nextActionHint: who applies it in the editor, optional
brainstormingDecisions.nextActionOptional: optional · carries no authority over the decision
brainstormingDecisions.nextActionPlaceholder: What happens next in the editor?
brainstormingDecisions.replacesHint: optional · it is superseded when this one is accepted
brainstormingDecisions.titleHint: from the first line of the conclusion · editing detaches it
brainstormingDecisions.registerHelp: Registering does not change your content.
brainstormingDecisions.proposalHelp: Saving a proposal does not accept it or change your content.
brainstormingDecisions.discardHelp: Your unsaved changes will be discarded. The saved decision and its history will remain.
brainstormingDecisions.changedProposalHelp: Review the current proposal below. Your text is preserved in the form; continuing will let you save it as a new revision.

errors.offline: Connection interrupted. Your text is kept here. Check the saved decision before retrying.
errors.unavailable: The decision could not be loaded or saved. Check your access and try again.
errors.stale_board: The exploration changed. Reopen decisions to continue.
errors.stale_decision: This decision changed while you were editing. Your text is kept here; review the current version before continuing.
errors.stale_sources: A source changed. Review the source preview before saving.
errors.sources_unavailable: A source is no longer accessible. Remove or replace it before continuing.
errors.targets_unavailable: Some affected content is no longer available. Remove it before saving.
errors.invalid_decision: Add a conclusion, choose what the decision means and an eligible responsible person.
errors.invalid_decision_targets: A decision can affect up to five different Sheets, Flows or Scenes.
errors.invalid_replacement: Only an accepted decision of this exploration can be replaced.
errors.replaced_decision_unavailable: The decision this one replaces is no longer in force. Edit the proposal before accepting it.
errors.ineligible_responsible: Choose a responsible person who can edit this project.
errors.ineligible_next_action_owner: Choose an owner for the next action who can edit this project.
errors.responsible_busy: Team permissions are being updated. Your text is kept here; try again in a moment.
errors.proposal_in_progress: Finish or leave your open proposal before starting another action.
errors.cannot_assign_responsible: Only the current responsible person or the project owner can reassign this decision.
errors.not_decision_responsible: Only the responsible person can accept this decision.
errors.already_accepted: This decision has already been accepted.
errors.decision_retired: This decision was withdrawn or superseded and can no longer change.
errors.not_withdrawable: Only a proposal waiting for acceptance can be withdrawn.
errors.cannot_withdraw: Only the person who proposed it or the project owner can withdraw this proposal.
errors.not_applicable: Application is declared after the decision is accepted.
errors.invalid_application: Choose affected content of the accepted decision.
errors.application_limit_reached: This decision has reached its limit of application records.
errors.private_mode: Decisions are available when the exploration is in shared mode.
errors.session_archived: Reopen the exploration before changing its decisions.
errors.decision_limit_reached: This exploration has reached its decision limit.
errors.decision_history_limit: This decision has reached its history limit.
errors.source_context_limit: These sources contain too much text. Choose a smaller set.
errors.idempotency_conflict: This request was already used for different changes. Review the saved decision before trying again.
